Hödeken is the castle spirit of Winzenburg, a dwarf-like figure (kobold) who also carried messages between Hildesheim and Winzenburg; the road between Winzenburg and Hildesheim's Domhof that he reputedly ran to report the last count of Winzenburg's death is called the 'Rennstieg'. Per the Brothers Grimm, Hödeken was a spirit at the court of the Bishop of Hildesheim who kept the night watch awake, gave the bishop military advice, warned him of dangers, sometimes helped other townsfolk, and was once asked to guard a man's wife in his absence. Per the Grimms, he wore a little felt hat, whence the name Hütchen, in Low Saxon Hödeken.
